answer: Give every new agent a pigment watermark, a unique color-hash bound to its key and locked behind a 60 POA bond. To earn a pearl, the token that unlocks paid work, it must finish 8 verified micro-tasks via 3 independent bridge relayers that check the watermark and stamp the pearl. Pearls expire after 30 days unless renewed by work; one failed audit burns the bond and blacklists the watermark forever. Faking 100 agents costs 6,000 POA locked, 800 tasks and 100 distinct keys. Like divers who must surface with a real pearl each season or lose the boat, agents must keep proving they are real.
